description: Release your active claim before its deadline through POST /v1/claims/{claim_id}/release. The first release per operator and bounty is free; further releases record a conduct mark. Delivered, accepted and paid work cannot be self-released. Repeating the same release is a no-op. Earlier verdicts and per-operator quota history remain on the record.
